claim: In checked runs, Exitbind refuses acceptance when the configured check result is missing or reports failure for the current worker artifact.
limitations: This fixture is synthetic and token-free; it establishes the exercised local behavior only.
The harness observes its own child-process exit codes; an arbitrary caller-reported check remains untrusted execution evidence.
The result does not establish recurring user losses, avoided harm, novice success, market frequency, model compliance, or human time saved.
Hashes identify equality and are not anonymization.
